name: Meltdown
source:
A short one-choice visual novel which tells the story of a person who hated holidays experiencing a catastrophe in the middle of one winter night.

[Edited from [url=https://izumi-games.itch.io/meltdown]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部简短的单选视觉小说，讲述了一个讨厌假期的人在一个冬夜经历一场灾难的故事。

[编辑自[url=https://izumi-games.itch.io/meltdown]itch.io[/url]]
